targetQualifications.text:
### Kontoplan, kildeprojektion og historiske rolleaktører (Group179)

Kildens fire kontooperationer bruger små fælles typed helpers i company_setup.
Nye identiteter kommer fra aktuelle credentials; native human wrappers beholder
deres hidtidige kald. Den oprindelige eksplicitte rollebekræftelse opretter en
ny version selv ved samme konto, mens den native wrapper beholder idempotens.
Kildeprojektionen viser otte krævede roller; de to valgfrie FX-roller bevares
i det native forløb. Forslag er diagnostik og giver ingen autoritet.

Kontoflagget indsættes atomisk og bruger én eksisterende account_created-audit
i stedet for TypeScript-navnet accounts_add. Flagget beskytter de eksisterende
afgrænsede bad-debt/claim-forløb; der er ikke indført en generel journalpolitik.
En gyldig source-created false-konto afvises af den eksisterende bad-debt-kontrol,
mens samme fixture lykkes med en almindelig udgiftskonto. Den generelle manual
postingforskel er fortsat åbent produktscope og hævdes ikke løst her.

SDK skelner mellem historisk proveniens og nutidige credentialassertioner:
native_seed/system samt bevarede typed agent/system-aktører kan læses; de
giver ingen adgang i dag. Inputnormalisering bevarer trimmede kontofelter og
kildens case-insensitive true/false. MCP Add har appliedRules på ydre niveau;
role-confirm bevarer coreok i data.ok, og CLI-afvisninger bevarer rollediagnostik.
Begge CLI-skrivninger kræver eksplicit --confirm yes.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account_role_mappings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('bank','debtors','creditors','output_vat','input_vat','reverse_charge_vat','vat_settlement','operational_default')),
  account_no TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_no),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed' CHECK(status IN ('confirmed','superseded','inactive')),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  confirmed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  confirmation_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'explicit' CHECK(confirmation_source IN ('native_seed','explicit')),
  confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(role, version)
);

  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('bank','debtors','creditors','output_vat','input_vat','reverse_charge_vat','vat_settlement','operational_default')),
  account_no TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_no),
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK(status IN ('proposed','rejected','accepted')),
  proposed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(role, account_no, source)
);

  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('asset','liability','equity','income','expense','vat')),
  normal_balance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(normal_balance IN ('debit','credit')),

  allow_direct_posting INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

### Kontoplan, kildeprojektion og historiske rolleaktører (Group179)

Kildens fire kontooperationer bruger små fælles typed helpers i company_setup.
Nye identiteter kommer fra aktuelle credentials; native human wrappers beholder
deres hidtidige kald. Den oprindelige eksplicitte rollebekræftelse opretter en
ny version selv ved samme konto, mens den native wrapper beholder idempotens.
Kildeprojektionen viser otte krævede roller; de to valgfrie FX-roller bevares
i det native forløb. Forslag er diagnostik og giver ingen autoritet.

Kontoflagget indsættes atomisk og bruger én eksisterende account_created-audit
i stedet for TypeScript-navnet accounts_add. Flagget beskytter de eksisterende
afgrænsede bad-debt/claim-forløb; der er ikke indført en generel journalpolitik.
En gyldig source-created false-konto afvises af den eksisterende bad-debt-kontrol,
mens samme fixture lykkes med en almindelig udgiftskonto. Den generelle manual
postingforskel er fortsat åbent produktscope og hævdes ikke løst her.

SDK skelner mellem historisk proveniens og nutidige credentialassertioner:
native_seed/system samt bevarede typed agent/system-aktører kan læses; de
giver ingen adgang i dag. Inputnormalisering bevarer trimmede kontofelter og
kildens case-insensitive true/false. MCP Add har appliedRules på ydre niveau;
role-confirm bevarer coreok i data.ok, og CLI-afvisninger bevarer rollediagnostik.
Begge CLI-skrivninger kræver eksplicit --confirm yes.

account_role_mappings.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account_role_mappings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('bank','debtors','creditors','output_vat','input_vat','reverse_charge_vat','vat_settlement','operational_default')),

bank_journal_reconciliation_links.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_journal_reconciliation_links (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  match_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(match_method IN ('exact-date-amount','settlement-lag-amount','source-reference','manual-review')),
  source_reference TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by_program TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rentemester',

bank_reconciliation_correction_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  supersedes_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_kind IN ('direct','append-only','correction')),
  supersedes_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_id > 0),
  supersedes_reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  superseded_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  replacement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  bank_account_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  bank_amount_dkk REAL NOT NULL,
  replacement_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(replacement_journal_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(bank_transaction_id, replacement_journal_entry_id),
  CHECK(supersedes_reconciliation_id = supersedes_kind || ':' || supersedes_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_transactions (

  message TEXT,
  archive_reference TEXT,
  customer_reference TEXT,
  balance_after NUMERIC,
  raw_json TEXT
  -- ===== END BANK CLUSTER (#186-189,#182) =====
);

documents.sql:

journal_entries.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_entries (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  entry_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  transaction_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  registration_datetime TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_bank_transaction_id INTEGER,
  document_id INTEGER,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DKK',
  amount_foreign NUMERIC,
  amount_dkk NUMERIC,
  fx_rate_to_dkk NUMERIC,
  rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,

journal_lines.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_lines (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  account_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  debit_amount NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(debit_amount >= 0),
  credit_amount NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(credit_amount >= 0),
  vat_code TEXT,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DKK',
  text TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY(journal_entry_id) REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id),
  CHECK(NOT (debit_amount > 0 AND credit_amount > 0))
);

payable_payments.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payable_payments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  payable_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER,
  journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DKK',
  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY(payable_id) REFERENCES payables(id),
  FOREIGN KEY(bank_transaction_id) REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  FOREIGN KEY(journal_entry_id) REFERENCES journal_entries(id)
);

payables.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payables (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  vendor_id INTEGER,
  supplier_name TEXT,
  bill_no TEXT,
  bill_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  gross_amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(gross_amount > 0),
  net_amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(net_amount >= 0),
  vat_amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(vat_amount >= 0),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DKK',
  journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents(id),
  FOREIGN KEY(vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(id),
  FOREIGN KEY(journal_entry_id) REFERENCES journal_entries(id)
);

transitiveLocalBehaviorDefinitions.typescript:
function canonicalEntryData(entry: any, lines: any[]) {
  return {
    id: entry.id ?? null,
    entry_no: entry.entry_no,
    transaction_date: entry.transaction_date,
    text: entry.text,
    source_bank_transaction_id: entry.source_bank_transaction_id ?? null,
    document_id: entry.document_id ?? null,
    currency: entry.currency ?? 'DKK',
    amount_foreign: entry.amount_foreign ?? null,
    amount_dkk: entry.amount_dkk ?? null,
    fx_rate_to_dkk: entry.fx_rate_to_dkk ?? null,
    rule_version: entry.rule_version,
    created_by: entry.created_by,
    created_by_program: entry.created_by_program,
    status: entry.status,
    reversal_of_entry_id: entry.reversal_of_entry_id ?? null,
    lines: lines.map((line, ordinal) => ({
      ordinal,
      account_no: line.account_no,
      debit_amount: normalizeAmount(line.debit_amount),
      credit_amount: normalizeAmount(line.credit_amount),
      vat_code: line.vat_code ?? null,
      text: line.text ?? null,
    })),
  };
}

definition.language: MCP tools/call result versus JSON-RPC transport error
definition.inputFailure: For tool audit_verify, input violating the inputSchema/Zod expression is rejected before callback. Application reply is result:{content:[{type:"text",text:string}],isError:true}, structuredContent absent. Text contains "MCP error -32602: Input validation error: Invalid arguments for tool audit_verify: " followed by Zod diagnostics (field path, expected type/constraint, message). -32602 is in text, not a numeric code field on CallToolResult; no business errors[] and no business handler effects. Malformed JSON/JSON-RPC request is transport-owned and may instead be JSON-RPC error {code:number,message:string,data?:JsonValue}, not this envelope.
definition.otherFailures: Unknown/disabled tool or thrown exception escaping runtime is SDK-owned isError text without structuredContent. Successful output is SDK-validated against envelopeShape; isError:true bypasses that output validation. SDK diagnostic string details are dependency-version-sensitive; source server instructions misdescribe this as a raw JSON-RPC error, while the concrete checked-in agent contract example is result.isError text.
definition.scope: stdio JSON-RPC framing and initialize are transport operations, not CLI parse exits or HTTP status.

wire.casing: Exact field spelling/case is defined by inputSchema and expanded per-operation output above. Raw SQL columns retain snake_case; only displayed explicit mappings convert to camelCase. No global casing conversion.
wire.nullability: null is preserved only where union/schema/explicit ??null constructs allow it; optional undefined object fields are omitted by JSON.stringify. SQL NULL remains JSON null; raw parsed JSON preserves its own nullability. Do not coerce absent data to null.
wire.stdout: stdio stdout contains MCP JSON-RPC transport frames, not a CLI envelope line per operation. CallToolResult content[0].text is JSON.stringify(envelope).
wire.stderr: No per-tool stderr success payload. Shared safeErrorEnvelope logs full error on console.error with [mcp:context] and returns path-redacted text; paths may therefore appear only in host-side stderr. Additional logging is defined in displayed adapter/core.
wire.exitCodes: Not applicable to individual MCP tools/call: refusal is CallToolResult isError, not process exit 1/2. Stdio server remains alive; startup/fatal transport failures are server-level.
wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Business result {content:[{type:"text",text:JSON.stringify(E)}],isError:!E.ok,structuredContent:E}. Parse/SDK exception result has isError:true text and NO structuredContent. Never parse text as an envelope when structuredContent is absent.

retry.identity: Receipt identity where key-idempotent is (client_key_hash, operation, ledger_uuid, authenticated principal kind+subjectId), never path or advisory actor. Same validated canonical payload replays; changed payload conflicts; expired outcome keeps key reserved. Natural/provider retry identities are exactly the displayed domain algorithm; annotation alone is not proof of safe retry. Unsafe-read-back requires canonical-state inspection before a new attempt.

interfaceOnlyBoundaries.ownershipBasis: Business responsibility determined from verifyAuditChain in src/core/ledger.ts; direct SQL/helper behavior is in adapterAlgorithm/localBehaviorDefinitions. Shared authorization/read/transport gates do not transfer business ownership.
interfaceOnlyBoundaries.excludedSurfaces: This row binds the original MCP name only; CLI/HTTP route schemas, flags and status/exit behavior are not asserted identical. Explicit global CLI-only exclusions below are binding.

operationExclusions: No additional operation-level exclusion is asserted; consult the exact global CLI/MCP mapping. Similar names do not promise identical CLI/HTTP schemas.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  original_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  reversal_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  payable_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payables(id),
  payment_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payable_payments(id),
  settlement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  document_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_hash)=64),
  original_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(original_journal_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(bank_transaction_id, settlement_journal_entry_id)
);

bank_reconciliation_correction_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  supersedes_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_kind IN ('direct','append-only','correction')),
  supersedes_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_id > 0),
  supersedes_reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  superseded_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  replacement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  bank_account_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  bank_amount_dkk REAL NOT NULL,
  replacement_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(replacement_journal_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(bank_transaction_id, replacement_journal_entry_id),
  CHECK(supersedes_reconciliation_id = supersedes_kind || ':' || supersedes_id)
);

definition.language: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 plus Zod execution semantics

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

bankTransactionId.description: Optional id of a single unmatched bank transaction to suggest matches for. When omitted, ALL unmatched bank transactions are scored (ordered by transaction_date DESC, id DESC) — no implicit pagination is applied at this level. Use this to target a single transaction, e.g. after a partial import or when reviewing one row in the UI.

max.description: Maximum number of match suggestions returned PER bank transaction (not total). Default: 5. Suggestions are sorted by confidence DESC, then documentId ASC, then truncated. The result's `rows` array itself is NOT truncated by `max` — every unmatched bank transaction in scope produces exactly one row (with up to `max` suggestions); if you need to limit the number of rows, target a single transaction via bankTransactionId, or narrow the bank import. See #381 for the related pagination contract.

definition.zodRegistration:
server.registerTool(
    "bank_suggest_matches",
    {
      title: "Suggest bank-transaction matches",
      description:
        "Foreslår deterministiske match mellem uafstemte banktransaktioner og fakturaer/bilag. " +
        "Read-only.\n\n" +
        "Matching-signaler (deterministiske, kombineres til en konfidens-score): " +
        "(1) eksakt beløb i øre mod åben saldo (issued invoice), gross-beløb (purchase_sale, " +
        "credit_note_refund) eller delvist refunderet beløb (supplier_credit_refund); " +
        "(2) invoice number / kreditnota-nummer / krediteret fakturanummer fundet som " +
        "substring i bank-tekst/reference/counterparty/message (case-insensitive); " +
        "(3) navne-tokens overlappende mellem bank-tekst og kunde-/leverandørnavn " +
        "(stop-ord som ApS/A/S/DKK fjernes); (4) dato-nærhed (faktura: 7 dage, " +
        "kreditnota: 14 dage); plus for supplier_credit_refund kræves et eksplicit " +
        "refund-cue (KREDIT/KREDITNOTA/REFUSION/REFUND/TILBAGEBETALING/CREDIT).\n\n" +
        "Confidence-skala: float i intervallet 0..1. Forslag under 0.5 returneres ikke. " +
        "Et match der kun bygger på beløb (uden invoice-nummer eller stærk navne-match " +
        "med ≥2 tokens) kappes til 0.45 og dukker derfor ikke op — dvs. enhver " +
        "returneret confidence ≥ 0.5 har altid mindst én identificerende corroboration. " +
        "Typiske intervaller: 0.50–0.65 svag/usikker, 0.65–0.80 god, ≥ 0.80 stærk. " +
        "En sikker auto-godkendelses-grænse er typisk ≥ 0.80.\n\n" +
        "Returnerer en envelope med data.rows: en række per uafstemt banktransaktion, " +
        "hver med felterne bankTransactionId, date, text, amount (DKK), currency, " +
        "reference og suggestions[]. Hver suggestion har { kind: 'issued_invoice' | " +
        "'purchase_sale' | 'credit_note_refund' | 'supplier_credit_refund', documentId, " +
        "invoiceNo, customerName?, supplierName?, confidence, reasons[] } sorteret efter " +
        "confidence faldende, derefter documentId stigende (deterministisk).\n\n" +
        "Rækkefølge på uafstemte transaktioner: transaction_date DESC, id DESC " +
        "(nyeste først, deterministisk). " +
        "Suggestions-listen pr. række er truncated til `max` (default 5); selve `rows` " +
        "er IKKE truncated af `max` (én række pr. uafstemt transaktion i scope, jf. #381).",
      inputSchema: {
        company: z.string().min(1).describe("Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug."),
        bankTransactionId: z
          .number()
          .int()
          .positive()
          .optional()
          .describe(
            "Optional id of a single unmatched bank transaction to suggest matches for. " +
              "When omitted, ALL unmatched bank transactions are scored (ordered by " +
              "transaction_date DESC, id DESC) — no implicit pagination is applied at " +
              "this level. Use this to target a single transaction, e.g. after a partial " +
              "import or when reviewing one row in the UI.",
          ),
        max: z
          .number()
          .int()
          .positive()
          .optional()
          .describe(
            "Maximum number of match suggestions returned PER bank transaction (not " +
              "total). Default: 5. Suggestions are sorted by confidence DESC, then " +
              "documentId ASC, then truncated. The result's `rows` array itself is NOT " +
              "truncated by `max` — every unmatched bank transaction in scope produces " +
              "exactly one row (with up to `max` suggestions); if you need to limit the " +
              "number of rows, target a single transaction via bankTransactionId, or " +
              "narrow the bank import. See #381 for the related pagination contract.",
          ),
      },
      outputSchema: envelopeShape,
      annotations: { readOnlyHint: true, destructiveHint: false, idempotentHint: true, openWorldHint: false },
    },
    withCompanyDb<{ company: string; bankTransactionId?: number; max?: number }>(
      server,
      ({ db, args }) => {
        const result = suggestBankMatches(db, {
          bankTransactionId: args.bankTransactionId,
          max: args.max,
        });
        return wrapCoreResult(result);
      },
    ),
  )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_accounts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  bank_name TEXT,
  registration_no TEXT,
  account_no TEXT,
  iban TEXT,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DKK',
  ledger_account_no TEXT,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY(ledger_account_no) REFERENCES accounts(account_no)
);

bank_transactions.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_transactions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  transaction_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  booking_date TEXT,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

csvPath.description: Absolute path to the CSV file ON THE MCP SERVER'S FILESYSTEM. Provide either csvPath or csvContent; csvPath wins if both are set.

csvContent.description: Raw CSV text, used as an inline alternative to csvPath when the file does not exist on the server. Provide either csvPath or csvContent.

account.description: Optional bank account identifier — the `slug` field returned by `bank_account_list` (or the human-readable name). When omitted, the company's default bank account is used. An unknown account aborts the import with a clear error before parsing.

profile.description: Optional named CSV import profile that pins the file's delimiter, encoding, date order and column→field mapping. Known value: 'danske-bank' (Danske Bank account-statement export). When omitted, the generic CSV parser is used (auto-detected headers). An unknown profile aborts the import before parsing.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

definition.language: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 plus Zod execution semantics

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

name.description: Customer name. Required unless fromCvr is given (then the CVR register supplies it).

vatOrCvr.description: VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678' (Danish) or 'DE123456789' (EU).

eanNumber.description: 13-digit EAN/GLN number — required to invoice this customer as a Danish public-sector recipient.

paymentTermsDays.description: Default payment terms in days (a positive integer). Used as the invoice due-date offset.

defaultCurrency.description: Default 3-letter ISO currency code for this customer's invoices, e.g. 'DKK' or 'EUR'.

input.description: Customer master-data fields. Fields left unset are filled from the CVR register when fromCvr is supplied.

fromCvr.description: Optional Danish CVR number. When set, every field not present in `input` is filled from the official CVR register before the customer is created.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

definition.validation: Exact case-sensitive keys. JSON Schema describes advertised input; Zod code is normative for transforms/refinements/defaults/unknown-key stripping. z.object defaults to stripping unknown keys unless passthrough/record is explicit. Optional does not imply nullable. No string/number coercion unless the displayed Zod expression requests it.

customers.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  address TEXT,
  vat_or_cvr TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  website TEXT,
  ean_number TEXT,
  -- EJER-3: NULL = ingen eksplicit kundefrist — fakturaen arver virksomhedens
  -- profilfrist (companies.payment_terms_days) på fakturatidspunktet.
  payment_terms_days INTEGER CHECK(payment_terms_days IS NULL OR payment_terms_days > 0),
  default_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DKK',
  notes TEXT,
  archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(vat_or_cvr, name)
);

transitiveLocalBehaviorDefinitions.typescript:
export function storeCvrLookup(
  db: Database,
  company: CvrCompanyInfo,
  meta: { rawResponse?: string | null; fetchedAt: string; expiresAt: string },
): void {
  db.query(
    `INSERT INTO cvr_lookups (
       cvr, name, address, postal_code, city, municipality_code,
       company_form_code, company_form_short, company_form_long, status,
       industry_code, industry_text, email, phone, website, start_date,
       fiscal_year_start, fiscal_year_end, audit_waived, share_capital,
       share_capital_currency, employees, advertising_protected,
       management_json, raw_response, fetched_at, expires_at
     ) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
     ON CONFLICT(cvr) DO UPDATE SET
       name = excluded.name, address = excluded.address,
       postal_code = excluded.postal_code, city = excluded.city,
       municipality_code = excluded.municipality_code,
       company_form_code = excluded.company_form_code,
       company_form_short = excluded.company_form_short,
       company_form_long = excluded.company_form_long, status = excluded.status,
       industry_code = excluded.industry_code, industry_text = excluded.industry_text,
       email = excluded.email, phone = excluded.phone, website = excluded.website,
       start_date = excluded.start_date, fiscal_year_start = excluded.fiscal_year_start,
       fiscal_year_end = excluded.fiscal_year_end, audit_waived = excluded.audit_waived,
       share_capital = excluded.share_capital,
       share_capital_currency = excluded.share_capital_currency,
       employees = excluded.employees,
       advertising_protected = excluded.advertising_protected,
       management_json = excluded.management_json, raw_response = excluded.raw_response,
       fetched_at = excluded.fetched_at, expires_at = excluded.expires_at`,
  ).run(
    company.cvr,
    company.name,
    company.address,
    company.postalCode,
    company.city,
    company.municipalityCode,
    company.companyFormCode,
    company.companyFormShort,
    company.companyFormLong,
    company.status,
    company.industryCode,
    company.industryText,
    company.email,
    company.phone,
    company.website,
    company.startDate,
    company.fiscalYearStart,
    company.fiscalYearEnd,
    company.auditWaived === null ? null : company.auditWaived ? 1 : 0,
    company.shareCapital,
    company.shareCapitalCurrency,
    company.employees,
    company.advertisingProtected ? 1 : 0,
    JSON.stringify(company.management),
    meta.rawResponse ?? null,
    meta.fetchedAt,
    meta.expiresAt,
  );
}
