transitiveLocalBehaviorDefinitions.typescript: function append(db:Database,id:string,type:RecordType,event:string,payload:object,actor:string,at:string){const body=canonical(payload),digest=hash(body);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_events(record_id,event_type,record_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,event,storageType(type),digest,body,requireText(actor,"actor",160),at);return digest;}

function assertLinkTarget(db:Database,type:LinkType,id:string) { if(type==="party" && !db.query("SELECT 1 FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='created'").get(id)) throw new Error("linked party does not exist"); }

export function linkCorporateRecord(db:Database,input:{recordId:string;type:LinkType;id:string;actor:string;at?:string}) {if(!["company","party","ownership","disposition","legacy_evidence_ref"].includes(input.type))throw new Error("unsupported record link type");const record=inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId);if(!record)throw new Error("corporate record not found");const id=requireText(input.id,"link id",256);assertLinkTarget(db,input.type,id);db.transaction(()=>{const at=input.at?iso(input.at,"at"):new Date().toISOString();db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_links(record_id,link_type,link_id) VALUES(?,?,?)").run(input.recordId,input.type,id);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions(record_id,scope_kind,scope_id,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.recordId,input.type,id,requireText(input.actor,"actor",160),at);append(db,input.recordId,record.type,"linked",{type:input.type,id},input.actor,at);})();return inspectCorporateRecord(db,input.recordId)!;}

export function inspectCorporateRecord(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at,canonical_payload FROM rm_corporate_record_events WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}
function storageType(type:RecordType):typeof STORAGE_TYPES[number] { return (STORAGE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type) ? type as typeof STORAGE_TYPES[number] : "other"; }

transitiveLocalBehaviorDefinitions.typescript: function append(db:Database,id:string,type:RecordType,event:string,payload:object,actor:string,at:string){const body=canonical(payload),digest=hash(body);db.query("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO rm_corporate_record_events(record_id,event_type,record_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,event,storageType(type),digest,body,requireText(actor,"actor",160),at);return digest;}

function assertLinkTarget(db:Database,type:LinkType,id:string) { if(type==="party" && !db.query("SELECT 1 FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='created'").get(id)) throw new Error("linked party does not exist"); }

export function inspectCorporateRecord(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT * FROM rm_corporate_record_bytes WHERE record_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,payload_hash,actor,created_at,canonical_payload FROM rm_corporate_record_events WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}
function storageType(type:RecordType):typeof STORAGE_TYPES[number] { return (STORAGE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type) ? type as typeof STORAGE_TYPES[number] : "other"; }

sharedGates: After schema validation, confirm!==true => {ok:false,errors:["confirm: true required for write tool corporate_record_link"],code:"CONFIRM_REQUIRED"}; handler is not called. Actor allowlist checked before writable ledger opening; refusal code ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED with path-redacted reason.

Company slug resolves only in configured workspace manifest; parent-directory segments rejected. Uninitialized/missing ledger => "company path does not exist or is not initialized". Read snapshot with noncurrent schema => {ok:false,errors:[`schema_${status}: current=${currentVersion} required=${requiredVersion}`],data:{schema}}; schema is inspectOpenLedger result. No migrations/sidecars for company reads. Exceptions become path-redacted errors with full server-side stderr.

When service security context exists, missing/revoked/insufficient live credentials => {ok:false,errors:["missing or invalid credentials"],code:"MCP_UNAUTHORIZED"}. Handshake actor is advisory attribution, never authenticated authority. Without context local trusted stdio mode does not invent authentication.

Outer backup guard runs BEFORE callback/confirm/security callback when resolvable company db exists; opens/migrates and checks lock; locked => code BACKUP_LOCKED with instruction naming corporate_record_link and system_backup_status/system_backup archive:true/system_backup_place. Thus missing-confirm is not a guarantee of zero cross-cutting migration effects in this legacy wrapper.

ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}

definition.inputFailure: For tool corporate_record_enrich, input violating the inputSchema/Zod expression is rejected before callback. definition.otherFailures: Unknown/disabled tool or thrown exception escaping runtime is SDK-owned isError text without structuredContent. wire.casing: Exact field spelling/case is defined by inputSchema and expanded per-operation output above. Raw SQL columns retain snake_case; only displayed explicit mappings convert to camelCase. No global casing conversion.
wire.nullability: null is preserved only where union/schema/explicit ??null constructs allow it; optional undefined object fields are omitted by JSON.stringify. SQL NULL remains JSON null; raw parsed JSON preserves its own nullability. Do not coerce absent data to null.
wire.stdout: stdio stdout contains MCP JSON-RPC transport frames, not a CLI envelope line per operation. CallToolResult content[0].text is JSON.stringify(envelope).
wire.stderr: No per-tool stderr success payload. Shared safeErrorEnvelope logs full error on console.error with [mcp:context] and returns path-redacted text; paths may therefore appear only in host-side stderr. Additional logging is defined in displayed adapter/core.
wire.exitCodes: Not applicable to individual MCP tools/call: refusal is CallToolResult isError, not process exit 1/2. Stdio server remains alive; startup/fatal transport failures are server-level.
wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Business result {content:[{type:"text",text:JSON.stringify(E)}],isError:!E.ok,structuredContent:E}. Parse/SDK exception result has isError:true text and NO structuredContent. Never parse text as an envelope when structuredContent is absent.

retry.identity: Receipt identity where key-idempotent is (client_key_hash, operation, ledger_uuid, authenticated principal kind+subjectId), never path or advisory actor. Same validated canonical payload replays; changed payload conflicts; expired outcome keeps key reserved. Natural/provider retry identities are exactly the displayed domain algorithm; annotation alone is not proof of safe retry. Unsafe-read-back requires canonical-state inspection before a new attempt.

function storedEndings(db: Database) { return new Map((db.query("SELECT fact_hash,MIN(effective_to_exclusive) AS end_at FROM rm_ownership_fact_events WHERE event_type='ended' GROUP BY fact_hash").all() as any[]).map(row=>[row.fact_hash,row.end_at as string])); }
function withEnd(fact: OwnershipFactInput, end?: string): OwnershipFactInput { return end&&(!fact.validToExclusive||end<fact.validToExclusive)?{...fact,validToExclusive:end}:fact; }

ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

coreBehaviorDefinitions.typescript: export function settleIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;settlementEvidenceRecordIds:string[];actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(current.status==="settled")return current;if(current.status!=="posted")throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(!Array.isArray(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)||input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds.length<1)throw new Error("settlement requires source-linked evidence");for(const id of input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)if(!inspectCorporateRecord(db,text(id,"settlement evidence",160)))throw new Error("settlement corporate evidence does not exist");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"settled",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,settlementEvidenceRecordIds:[...new Set(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)].sort()},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

transitiveLocalBehaviorDefinitions.typescript: function lifecycle(db:Database,id:string,type:"settled"|"superseded"|"reopened"|"exception"|"exception_resolved",payload:unknown,actor:string,principal:DispositionPrincipal){const previous=db.query("SELECT event_hash FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get() as any;const body=canonical(payload),digest=sha(body),at=new Date().toISOString(),hash=sha(canonical({previousHash:previous?.event_hash??null,dispositionId:id,type,payloadHash:digest,actor,principal,at}));db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events(disposition_id,event_type,payload_hash,canonical_payload,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,previous_hash,event_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(id,type,digest,body,text(actor,"actor",160),principal.kind,text(principal.id,"principal id",160),previous?.event_hash??null,hash,at);insertWorkspaceAudit(db,{createdBy:actor,createdByProgram:"rentemester",eventType:`intercompany_disposition_${type}`,entityType:"intercompany_disposition",entityId:id});return {payloadHash:digest,eventHash:hash};}

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

function assertCurrentLinks(workspace:string,current:NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof state>>){for(const link of current.links){const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash)throw new Error("linked journal entry changed; disposition requires review");if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)throw new Error("linked ledger head changed; refresh and review before state change");}}

function parse(input:unknown):IntercompanyDisposition {const row=input&&typeof input==="object"&&!Array.isArray(input)?input as any:{};const side=(name:DispositionSide)=>{const item=row[name]??{};const companySlug=text(item.companySlug,`${name}.companySlug`,120);const expectedSide=text(item.expectedSide,`${name}.expectedSide`,20);if(expectedSide!=="receivable"&&expectedSide!=="payable")throw new Error(`${name}.expectedSide must be receivable or payable`);return {companySlug,role:text(item.role,`${name}.role`,80),expectedSide:expectedSide as "receivable"|"payable"};};const left=side("left"),right=side("right");if(left.companySlug===right.companySlug)throw new Error("disposition sides must reference distinct legal companies");if(left.expectedSide===right.expectedSide)throw new Error("disposition sides must be complementary");const type=text(row.type,"type",20);if(!["invoice","reimbursement","loan","capital","dividend","repayment","other"].includes(type))throw new Error("unsupported disposition type");const ids=(value:unknown,name:string)=>{if(!Array.isArray(value)||!value.length||value.length>64)throw new Error(`${name} requires 1 through 64 source-linked references`);const out=value.map((v,i)=>text(v,`${name}[${i}]`,160));if(new Set(out).size!==out.length)throw new Error(`${name} must be unique`);return out.sort();};return {dispositionId:row.dispositionId?text(row.dispositionId,"dispositionId",80):`icd-${randomUUID()}`,type:type as any,economicDate:date(row.economicDate,"economicDate"),amount:amount(row.amount,"amount"),currency:text(row.currency,"currency",3).toUpperCase(),...(row.settlementDueDate?{settlementDueDate:date(row.settlementDueDate,"settlementDueDate")}:{ }),partyIds:ids(row.partyIds,"partyIds"),evidenceRecordIds:ids(row.evidenceRecordIds,"evidenceRecordIds"),left,right};}

function snapshot(workspace:string,companySlug:string,journalEntryId:number){const db=openLedgerReadOnly(companyPaths(companyRootForSlug(workspace,companySlug)).db);try{db.exec("PRAGMA query_only=ON");const company=db.query("SELECT currency FROM companies WHERE id=1").get() as any;const entry=db.query("SELECT id,entry_no,transaction_date,entry_hash,status,reversal_of_entry_id FROM journal_entries WHERE id=?").get(journalEntryId)as any;if(!company||!entry||entry.status!=="posted"||entry.reversal_of_entry_id!=null)throw new Error("journal must be an active posted journal entry");const reversed=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reversal_of_entry_id=? LIMIT 1").get(journalEntryId);if(reversed)throw new Error("journal entry has been reversed");const lines=db.query("SELECT debit_amount,credit_amount FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_entry_id=?").all(journalEntryId)as any[];const head=db.query("SELECT entry_hash FROM journal_entries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get()as any;return {currency:String(company.currency).toUpperCase(),entry,lines,ledgerHeadHash:head?.entry_hash??null};}finally{db.close();}}

function state(db:Database,id:string){const row=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash FROM rm_intercompany_dispositions WHERE disposition_id=?").get(id)as any;if(!row)return null;const events=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const lifecycleEvents=db.query("SELECT event_type,actor,principal_kind,principal_id,payload_hash,canonical_payload,created_at FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_lifecycle_events WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const links=db.query("SELECT side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id FROM rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links WHERE disposition_id=? ORDER BY side").all(id)as any[];let status=events.some(event=>event.event_type==="approved")?"approved":"proposed";for(const item of lifecycleEvents){if(item.event_type==="settled"||item.event_type==="superseded")status=item.event_type;if(item.event_type==="reopened")status="approved";}if(status==="approved"){if(links.length===1)status="partly_posted";if(links.length===2)status="posted";}return {disposition:JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,status,events,lifecycleEvents,links};}

function assertCurrentLinks(workspace:string,current:NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof state>>){for(const link of current.links){const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash)throw new Error("linked journal entry changed; disposition requires review");if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)throw new Error("linked ledger head changed; refresh and review before state change");}}

function parse(input:unknown):IntercompanyDisposition {const row=input&&typeof input==="object"&&!Array.isArray(input)?input as any:{};const side=(name:DispositionSide)=>{const item=row[name]??{};const companySlug=text(item.companySlug,`${name}.companySlug`,120);const expectedSide=text(item.expectedSide,`${name}.expectedSide`,20);if(expectedSide!=="receivable"&&expectedSide!=="payable")throw new Error(`${name}.expectedSide must be receivable or payable`);return {companySlug,role:text(item.role,`${name}.role`,80),expectedSide:expectedSide as "receivable"|"payable"};};const left=side("left"),right=side("right");if(left.companySlug===right.companySlug)throw new Error("disposition sides must reference distinct legal companies");if(left.expectedSide===right.expectedSide)throw new Error("disposition sides must be complementary");const type=text(row.type,"type",20);if(!["invoice","reimbursement","loan","capital","dividend","repayment","other"].includes(type))throw new Error("unsupported disposition type");const ids=(value:unknown,name:string)=>{if(!Array.isArray(value)||!value.length||value.length>64)throw new Error(`${name} requires 1 through 64 source-linked references`);const out=value.map((v,i)=>text(v,`${name}[${i}]`,160));if(new Set(out).size!==out.length)throw new Error(`${name} must be unique`);return out.sort();};return {dispositionId:row.dispositionId?text(row.dispositionId,"dispositionId",80):`icd-${randomUUID()}`,type:type as any,economicDate:date(row.economicDate,"economicDate"),amount:amount(row.amount,"amount"),currency:text(row.currency,"currency",3).toUpperCase(),...(row.settlementDueDate?{settlementDueDate:date(row.settlementDueDate,"settlementDueDate")}:{ }),partyIds:ids(row.partyIds,"partyIds"),evidenceRecordIds:ids(row.evidenceRecordIds,"evidenceRecordIds"),left,right};}

function snapshot(workspace:string,companySlug:string,journalEntryId:number){const db=openLedgerReadOnly(companyPaths(companyRootForSlug(workspace,companySlug)).db);try{db.exec("PRAGMA query_only=ON");const company=db.query("SELECT currency FROM companies WHERE id=1").get() as any;const entry=db.query("SELECT id,entry_no,transaction_date,entry_hash,status,reversal_of_entry_id FROM journal_entries WHERE id=?").get(journalEntryId)as any;if(!company||!entry||entry.status!=="posted"||entry.reversal_of_entry_id!=null)throw new Error("journal must be an active posted journal entry");const reversed=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries WHERE reversal_of_entry_id=? LIMIT 1").get(journalEntryId);if(reversed)throw new Error("journal entry has been reversed");const lines=db.query("SELECT debit_amount,credit_amount FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_entry_id=?").all(journalEntryId)as any[];const head=db.query("SELECT entry_hash FROM journal_entries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").get()as any;return {currency:String(company.currency).toUpperCase(),entry,lines,ledgerHeadHash:head?.entry_hash??null};}finally{db.close();}}

wire.casing: Exact field spelling/case is defined by inputSchema and expanded per-operation output above. Raw SQL columns retain snake_case; only displayed explicit mappings convert to camelCase. No global casing conversion.
wire.nullability: null is preserved only where union/schema/explicit ??null constructs allow it; optional undefined object fields are omitted by JSON.stringify. SQL NULL remains JSON null; raw parsed JSON preserves its own nullability. Do not coerce absent data to null.
wire.stdout: stdio stdout contains MCP JSON-RPC transport frames, not a CLI envelope line per operation. CallToolResult content[0].text is JSON.stringify(envelope).
wire.stderr: No per-tool stderr success payload. Shared safeErrorEnvelope logs full error on console.error with [mcp:context] and returns path-redacted text; paths may therefore appear only in host-side stderr. Additional logging is defined in displayed adapter/core.
wire.exitCodes: Not applicable to individual MCP tools/call: refusal is CallToolResult isError, not process exit 1/2. Stdio server remains alive; startup/fatal transport failures are server-level.
wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Business result {content:[{type:"text",text:JSON.stringify(E)}],isError:!E.ok,structuredContent:E}. Parse/SDK exception result has isError:true text and NO structuredContent. Never parse text as an envelope when structuredContent is absent.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rm_company_membership_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(id) CHECK(length(trim(user_id)) > 0),
  company_slug TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(company_slug)) > 0),

  company_role TEXT CHECK(company_role IN ('owner', 'bookkeeper', 'reviewer', 'reader')),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) > 0),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CHECK(
    (event_type = 'grant' AND company_role IN ('owner', 'bookkeeper', 'reviewer', 'reader'))
    OR (event_type = 'revoke' AND company_role IS NULL)
  )
);

### Kildebundne leverandørforpligtelser og entydige MCP-navne (Group176)

Den tidligere TypeScript-plan brugte ren inputhash og en anden kalender.
Det oprindelige CLI/MCP-interface anvender nu den eksisterende native plan:
aktuel aktiv leverandør, originale kildebytes, proveniens, gennemgået input og
forrige hash bindes sammen. Horisonten er næste dato plus90dage inklusive;
månedsforekomster beholder deres oprindelige datoanker. Et angivet
leverandørsnapshot er en lighedsassertion, aldrig autoritet. Ikke-aktiv
startstatus afvises. Ingen native kilde- eller adgangskontrol svækkes.

Kildens ændringskommando uden forventet hash slår den aktuelle aktive hash
op i samme adgangskontrollerede transaktion. Pause kan derfor ikke afsluttes
direkte via dette interface; ny aktivering kræver et nyt gennemgået forslag.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_commitment_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 commitment_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(commitment_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 96),

 UNIQUE(idempotency_key)
);

### Kildebundne leverandørforpligtelser og entydige MCP-navne (Group176)

Den tidligere TypeScript-plan brugte ren inputhash og en anden kalender.
Det oprindelige CLI/MCP-interface anvender nu den eksisterende native plan:
aktuel aktiv leverandør, originale kildebytes, proveniens, gennemgået input og
forrige hash bindes sammen. Horisonten er næste dato plus90dage inklusive;
månedsforekomster beholder deres oprindelige datoanker. Et angivet
leverandørsnapshot er en lighedsassertion, aldrig autoritet. Ikke-aktiv
startstatus afvises. Ingen native kilde- eller adgangskontrol svækkes.

Kildens ændringskommando uden forventet hash slår den aktuelle aktive hash
op i samme adgangskontrollerede transaktion. Pause kan derfor ikke afsluttes
direkte via dette interface; ny aktivering kræver et nyt gennemgået forslag.
Det native interface beholder sin udtrykkelige forventede hash.
Kvitteringsgenfinding med kendt oprindelig nøgle går gennem native idempotens
efter aktuel adgang og fysisk kildekontrol; en ny plan må ikke afskære en
allerede gemt kvittering efter afslutning. Ingen automatisk mutation gentages.

Den oprindelige `supplier_commitment_matches`-form og den tidligere native
form får hver sit navn; nativeformen findes under
`native_supplier_commitment_matches`. Discovery indeholder348unikke navne.
Aktør og principal kommer fra aktuelle bruger-/servicecredentials og gemmes
med korrekt type; gamle native brugerkald bevarer deres kontrakt.

To misvisende testforventninger blev rettet fra konkrete resultater før
godkendelse: historisk registry-tal341 efter syv nye bindings og antagelsen
om direkte afslutning af en pause. Sidstnævnte blev rettet før første faktiske
prøve ved at bevare afvisningen og kræve gennemgået genaktivering.

transitiveLocalBehaviorDefinitions.typescript: export function listSupplierCommitments(db:Database){return db.query("SELECT commitment_id,payload_json,payload_hash,created_at FROM current_supplier_commitments ORDER BY commitment_id").all() as Array<{commitment_id:string;payload_json:string;payload_hash:string;created_at:string}>;}

function scheduledOccurrence(proposal:CommitmentProposal,date:string){let cursor=proposal.nextDate;for(let count=0;count<10000&&cursor<=date;count++){if(cursor===date&&(!proposal.endDate||cursor<=proposal.endDate))return {date:cursor,amount:proposal.amount,currency:proposal.currency};cursor=next(cursor,proposal.frequency);}return null;}

export function commitmentVariance(expected:{date:string;amount:number;currency:string},evidence:CanonicalEvidence,expectedPartyId?:string){const currencyMatch=expected.currency===evidence.currency;return {amount:currencyMatch?evidence.amount-expected.amount:null,dateDays:Math.round((Date.parse(evidence.date+"T00:00:00Z")-Date.parse(expected.date+"T00:00:00Z"))/86400000),late:evidence.date>expected.date,currency:{expected:expected.currency,actual:evidence.currency,status:currencyMatch?"same":"unsupported_fx"},party:{expected:expectedPartyId??null,actual:evidence.partyId,status:!evidence.partyId?"missing":evidence.partyId===expectedPartyId?"same":"mismatch"},documentation:evidence.documented?"present":"missing",comparability:currencyMatch?"native_currency":"unsupported_fx"};}

### Kildebundne leverandørforpligtelser og entydige MCP-navne (Group176)

Den tidligere TypeScript-plan brugte ren inputhash og en anden kalender.
Det oprindelige CLI/MCP-interface anvender nu den eksisterende native plan:
aktuel aktiv leverandør, originale kildebytes, proveniens, gennemgået input og
forrige hash bindes sammen. Horisonten er næste dato plus90dage inklusive;
månedsforekomster beholder deres oprindelige datoanker. Et angivet
leverandørsnapshot er en lighedsassertion, aldrig autoritet. Ikke-aktiv
startstatus afvises. Ingen native kilde- eller adgangskontrol svækkes.

Kildens ændringskommando uden forventet hash slår den aktuelle aktive hash
op i samme adgangskontrollerede transaktion. Pause kan derfor ikke afsluttes
direkte via dette interface; ny aktivering kræver et nyt gennemgået forslag.
Det native interface beholder sin udtrykkelige forventede hash.
Kvitteringsgenfinding med kendt oprindelig nøgle går gennem native idempotens
efter aktuel adgang og fysisk kildekontrol; en ny plan må ikke afskære en
allerede gemt kvittering efter afslutning. Ingen automatisk mutation gentages.

Den oprindelige `supplier_commitment_matches`-form og den tidligere native
form får hver sit navn; nativeformen findes under
`native_supplier_commitment_matches`. Discovery indeholder348unikke navne.
Aktør og principal kommer fra aktuelle bruger-/servicecredentials og gemmes
med korrekt type; gamle native brugerkald bevarer deres kontrakt.

To misvisende testforventninger blev rettet fra konkrete resultater før
godkendelse: historisk registry-tal341 efter syv nye bindings og antagelsen
om direkte afslutning af en pause. Sidstnævnte blev rettet før første faktiske
prøve ved at bevare afvisningen og kræve gennemgået genaktivering.

coreBehaviorDefinitions.typescript: export function supplierCommitmentAlerts(db:Database,asOf:string){if(!isValidIsoDate(asOf))return [];const end=addDays(asOf,30);const alerts:any[]=[];for(const row of listSupplierCommitments(db)){const p=JSON.parse(row.payload_json) as CommitmentProposal;for(const [kind,date] of [["notice",p.noticeDate],["renewal",p.renewalDate]] as const)if(date&&date>=asOf&&date<=end)alerts.push({commitmentId:row.commitment_id,kind,date,severity:date===asOf?"due":"upcoming"});}return alerts.sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)||a.commitmentId.localeCompare(b.commitmentId));}

wire.casing: Exact field spelling/case is defined by inputSchema and expanded per-operation output above. Raw SQL columns retain snake_case; only displayed explicit mappings convert to camelCase. No global casing conversion.
wire.nullability: null is preserved only where union/schema/explicit ??null constructs allow it; optional undefined object fields are omitted by JSON.stringify. SQL NULL remains JSON null; raw parsed JSON preserves its own nullability. Do not coerce absent data to null.
wire.stdout: stdio stdout contains MCP JSON-RPC transport frames, not a CLI envelope line per operation. CallToolResult content[0].text is JSON.stringify(envelope).
wire.stderr: No per-tool stderr success payload. Shared safeErrorEnvelope logs full error on console.error with [mcp:context] and returns path-redacted text; paths may therefore appear only in host-side stderr. Additional logging is defined in displayed adapter/core.
wire.exitCodes: Not applicable to individual MCP tools/call: refusal is CallToolResult isError, not process exit 1/2. Stdio server remains alive; startup/fatal transport failures are server-level.
wire.mcpTextStructuredContent: Business result {content:[{type:"text",text:JSON.stringify(E)}],isError:!E.ok,structuredContent:E}. Parse/SDK exception result has isError:true text and NO structuredContent. Never parse text as an envelope when structuredContent is absent.

retry.identity: Receipt identity where key-idempotent is (client_key_hash, operation, ledger_uuid, authenticated principal kind+subjectId), never path or advisory actor. ## CLI/MCP-mapping

MCP-surface'en er *tæt på* 1:1 med CLI'en, men **ikke fuldstændig**: der er
mindst 10 dokumenterede afvigelser fordelt på en CLI-only-liste og en
MCP-only-liste (se nedenfor). En agent der vælger MCP som primær overflade
finder altså IKKE alle CLI-only-funktionerne i `tools/list` — og omvendt.
Sektionerne nedenfor er maskinlæsbart udgivet: hver post navngiver den
underliggende kildefil i `src/cli/<x>.ts` eller `src/mcp/tools/<x>.ts`, så en
agent kan krydsverificere uden at læse kildekoden. Et CI-check
(`tests/unit/surface-diff-discoverable.test.ts`) fejler, hvis en ny
`src/cli/<x>.ts` eller `src/mcp/tools/<x>.ts` tilføjes uden at blive nævnt i
mapping-doc'en — `tæt på 1:1` er altså ikke længere et løst løfte, men en
konkret diff, der vedligeholdes pr. fil.

### MCP-only — tools uden CLI-pendant

- `src/mcp/tools/agent-discovery.ts` — `agent_capability_search` og
  `agent_workflow_describe` er read-only runtime-discovery for den versionerede
  outcome-katalog; de har ingen CLI-pendant.
- `src/mcp/tools/bookkeeping-workbench.ts` — `bookkeeping_workbench` er den
  read-only, kanoniske bankarbejdskø. Den viser den eksplicitte
  dokument-part-resolution og canonical party fra `current_document_party_links`
  (aldrig `documents.sender_name` som party-identitet), plus konto, moms og
  dimensioner. Filtre ændrer kun siden; `population.blockers` er altid for hele
  den kanoniske population. Følg række-drilldowns til bilag, party, bank,
  reviewet batch, journal og periodeluk, og brug derefter den eksisterende
  hash-bundne plan → persist → approve → apply-kontrakt for alle writes.

MCP-tools, der ikke findes på CLI'en (`src/mcp/tools/<filename>.ts` ⇒ intet
modsvar i `src/cli/`). En agent, der CLI-fortrinsstiller, vil aldrig opdage
disse uden at læse mapping-doc'en:

- `src/mcp/tools/cvr.ts` — `cvr_lookup` (CVR-opslag mod virk.dk). CLI'en har
  kun `customer cvr-lookup` (knyttet til `src/cli/customer.ts`); der findes
  ingen selvstændig `cvr`-kommando.
- `src/mcp/tools/peppol.ts` — `peppol_submit_public_invoice` (PEPPOL-submission
  af bogført faktura). CLI'en har `invoice submit-public-peppol`
  (`src/cli/invoice.ts`), men den er filtmæssigt en del af `invoice`-domænet
  — ikke en selvstændig `peppol`-CLI.
- `src/mcp/tools/efaktura.ts` — `efaktura_send` (LIVE Digisense-afsendelse af en
  udstedt offentlig e-faktura). CLI-pendanten er `invoice transmit-digisense`
  (underkommando i `src/cli/invoice/issuance.ts`), ikke en `efaktura send`-
  kommando — navnene divergerer, men begge kører samme
  `resolveDigisenseTransmitter` + `transmitPublicEInvoicePeppol`. Access-point-
  identiteten udledes deterministisk af companyKey (intet `--access-point` skal
  opfindes), så afsendelse er idempotent og leverer aldrig dobbelt.
- `src/mcp/tools/portfolio.ts` — `portfolio_overview` (workspace-vid
  porteføljeoversigt). CLI'en har kun `dashboard` (`src/cli/dashboard.ts`),
  der er virksomheds-scopet og kun delvist overlapper.
- `src/mcp/tools/period.ts` — `period_list` (lister regnskabsperioder).
  CLI'en har kun `period close`/`period reopen` (`src/cli/period.ts`) — der
  er ingen `period list`-kommando.

### CLI-only-kommandoer uden MCP-pendant

CLI-kommandoer, der ikke har et MCP-tool (`src/cli/<filename>.ts` ⇒ intet
modsvar i `src/mcp/tools/`). En agent, der MCP-fortrinsstiller, vil aldrig
opdage disse uden at læse mapping-doc'en. Genåbning af en lukket
regnskabsperiode (`period reopen`) er fx CLI-only — se også underafsnittet
"Andre kendte mikro-afvigelser" længere nede:

- `src/cli/agent.ts` — `agent run` (den pakkede runtime-agent-loop; egen
  kontrakt i `runtime-agent-contract.md`). Ingen `agent_*`-MCP-tools.
- `src/cli/annual-report.ts` — `report annual` og afledte årsrapport-flows.
  Ingen `annual_report_*`-MCP-tools.
- `src/cli/dashboard.ts` — `dashboard` (virksomheds-scopet nøgletal). MCP
  har det workspace-scopede `portfolio_overview` i stedet (se MCP-only
  ovenfor) — ikke et 1:1-modstykke.
- `src/cli/opening-balance.ts` — `opening-balance post` (etablerer
  primosaldo). Ingen `opening_balance_*`-MCP-tools.
- `src/cli/reg.ts` — `reg coverage` og `reg citations` (regulatorisk
  dækningsrapport + paragrafhenvisninger). Ingen `reg_*`-MCP-tools.
- `src/cli/compliance.ts` — `compliance report` (genererer en
  deterministisk, byte-stabil HTML-rapport til revisor eller myndighed
  med audit-kæde, backup-status, retention, GDPR, regulatorisk dækning
  og hele regel→paragraf-mappingen). Ingen `compliance_*`-MCP-tools.
- `src/cli/report.ts` — `report balance`, `report profit-loss`,
  `report trial-balance`, `report tax`. MCP har kun `tax_return_prepare`;
  resten er CLI-only.
- `src/cli/serve.ts` — `serve` (starter cockpit HTTP-API'en). Det er en
  proces-host og giver ikke mening som MCP-tool.
- `src/cli/group.ts` — strukturkommandoerne `validate-manifest`,
  `apply-manifest` og `overview` samt mellemregningskommandoerne
  `validate-mapping`, `propose-mapping`, `approve-mapping`, `revoke-mapping`
  og `reconcile`, samt balanceelimineringernes `propose-elimination`,
  `approve-elimination`, `reject-elimination`, `apply-elimination`,
  `reverse-elimination` og `eliminations`. Mappings og eliminationer har
  append-only lifecycle og særskilt reviewer;
  afstemning er read-only, eksplicit dateret og kun sammenlignelig i samme
  funktionsvaluta. Der er bevidst ingen MCP-vej, før en særskilt workspace-wide
  autorisationskontrakt er eksponeret der.
- `src/cli/workspace-access.ts` — `workspace-access bootstrap-first`:
  lokal, engangs bootstrap af workspace-ejer og medlemskaber. Den private
  sikkerhedsbootstrap må ikke udstilles som et generelt MCP-tool.
- `src/cli/workspace-snapshot.ts` — `workspace snapshot` og
  `workspace restore`: credential-fri, signeret flytning af et helt workspace
  med staged restore og eksplicit geninvitation af identiteter. Det er en
  administrativ backup-/recovery-grænse og udstilles ikke som MCP-tool.
- `src/cli/workspace-registry.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/workspace-registry.ts` —
  canonical parties og immutable corporate records med explicit company-scope,
  actor/confirm på writes og filtrering før pagination.
- `src/cli/workspace-registry.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/workspace-document-inbox.ts` —
  immutable workspace-indbakke med eksplicit, adgangskontrolleret routing og
  ét canonical company-handoff; kilden ligger aldrig i en workspace-hovedbog.
- `src/cli/group.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/intercompany-dispositions.ts` —
  source-linked two-sided disposition lifecycle. MCP requires live, narrow
  membership on both legal-company endpoints; it can plan, propose, approve,
  link, inspect, settle and reopen evidence, but never posts either ledger.
- `src/cli/report.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/cfo-analytics.ts` — versioneret,
  source-linked CFO-analyse over live journal og importarkiver. Portfolio er
  aldrig en konsolidering; group-scope delegerer kun til en godkendt profil.
- `src/cli/local.ts` — `local start`: loopback-only launcher for den simple
  én-virksomhedstilstand; det er en proces-host, ikke et MCP-tool.
- `src/cli/accounting-draft.ts` — det append-only fire-øjne-flow
  `create`/`revise`/`submit`/`reject`/`approve-and-post` samt `list`/`show`.
  Hosted HTTP håndhæver bogholder/reviewer-roller via Better Auth-medlemskab;
  CLI'en håndhæver actor-allowlist og forskellige actors, men workflowet
  udstilles ikke over MCP før samme rolle- og virksomhedsgrænse findes dér.
- `src/cli/bank-account.ts` — `bank-account add`/`bank-account list`
  (registrér/lis/opdatér bankkonti for FX-bogføring). MCP-surface'en eksponerer
  `bank_account_list` og confirm-gatede `bank_account_update`; oprettelse er
  fortsat CLI/cockpit-only.
- `src/cli/init.ts` — `init` (initialisér en virksomhed). MCP eksponerer
  `company_add` (`src/mcp/tools/system.ts`) i stedet, ikke `init` direkte.
- `src/cli/gdpr.ts` — kun slettevejen `gdpr forget` (legacy alias:
  `gdpr erase`) er CLI-only og kræver det eksplicitte flag
  `--after-retention-expiry` (exit `2` uden). `gdpr discover`, `gdpr export`
  og `gdpr audit-log` har nu direkte MCP-pendanter i `src/mcp/tools/gdpr.ts`;
  discover/export er actor- og `confirm`-gatede, mens audit-log-eksporten er
  read-only og kan signeres med en eksisterende Ed25519-backupnøgle.

**CLI-only på kommando-niveau** — filen har en MCP-tvilling, men disse
enkelt-kommandoer har intet MCP-tool (verificeret mod `rentemester --help`
og `tools/list`):

- `src/cli/company.ts` (tvilling: `src/mcp/tools/company.ts`) —
  `company list` (lister virksomheder i workspacet) og `company set-profile`
  (retter virksomhedens profil efter init) er CLI-only; MCP har kun
  `company_add`, `company_profile_get` og `company_sync_cvr`.
- `src/cli/system.ts` (tvilling: `src/mcp/tools/system.ts` +
  `src/mcp/tools/system/`) — seks kommandoer er CLI-only:
  `system export-saft` (SAF-T-eksport), `system export-public-key`,
  `system verify-backup-signature`, `system rotate-backup-keypair`,
  `system export-accountant` (håndoff-pakke til bogholder/revisor) og
  `system backup-guide` (HTML-guide).
- `src/cli/vat.ts` (tvilling: `src/mcp/tools/vat.ts`) —
  `vat momsangivelse` (alias: `vat filing`) er CLI-only; MCP har kun
  `vat_report`, `vat_eu_sales_list`, `vat_oss_report` og `vat_post_*`.
- `src/cli/import.ts` (tvilling: `src/mcp/tools/import.ts`) —
  `import run` (fuld migrering), `import systems` og `import contacts` er
  CLI-only; MCP har kun `import_archive_list`/`import_archive_year`.
- `src/cli/customer.ts` (tvilling: `src/mcp/tools/customer.ts`) —
  `customer cvr-lookup` har MCP-pendanten `cvr_lookup` (se MCP-only ovenfor);
  ingen kommandoer i filen er helt uden pendant, men navnene divergerer.

**Nye domæne-tvillinger** — disse filer har direkte, men ikke nødvendigvis
ord-for-ord, CLI/MCP-pendanter og er derfor hverken CLI-only eller MCP-only:

- `src/cli/bookkeeping-batch.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/bookkeeping-batch.ts` —
  planlægning, godkendelse og anvendelse af en hash-bundet batch.
- `src/cli/supplier-commitments.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/supplier-commitments.ts` —
  reviewede leverandørforpligtelser og deres deterministiske occurrence-flow.
- `src/cli/dimensions.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/dimensions.ts` — company-scoped,
  append-only dimension definitions and members, including activate,
  deactivate, rename and supersede lifecycle events with queryable historical
  labels, plus hash-bound journal-line allocations. Assignments never alter
  journal bytes, VAT or legal totals.
- `src/cli/posting-rules.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/posting-rules.ts` —
  forslag, lifecycle og dry-run forklaring af virksomheds-lokale
  konteringsregler.
- `src/cli/purchase-vat-preflight.ts` ↔ `src/mcp/tools/expense.ts` —
  `expense vat-preflight` og `expense_vat_preflight[_apply]`; MCP-værktøjet
  ligger under expense-domænet, mens CLI-adapteren bevidst er en selvstændig
  fil for at holde provider-I/O ude af posting-kernen.

> **Andre kendte mikro-afvigelser (samme filnavn, divergent klassifikation
> eller ergonomi):**
>
> - **`import_archive_year` har ingen selvstændig CLI-kommando.** Den henter
>   fra samme arkiv-artefakt som `import archive` skriver/lister
>   (`src/cli/import.ts`).
> - **`period reopen` er CLI-only.** En for tidligt lukket regnskabsperiode kan
>   kun genåbnes via CLI-kommandoen `period reopen` (en kontrolleret, fuldt
>   revisionssporet handling, #247) — der findes *ingen* `period_reopen`
>   MCP-tool. MCP-surface'en eksponerer `period_list` (read) og `period_close`
>   (write-irreversible), men ikke en genåbning. En agent der over MCP rammer
>   en lukket-periode-afvisning kan altså ikke selv genåbne perioden; den må
>   henvise mennesket til `rentemester period reopen`. HTTP-laget har
>   derimod `POST /api/companies/:slug/periods/reopen` — så cockpittet er
>   ikke begrænset på samme måde.
> - **`invoice create` er CLI-only — den ergonomiske CLI-vej til at fakturere.**
>   `invoice create` udsteder en kundefaktura uden at man selv skriver JSON eller
>   regner moms (linjer som `"beskrivelse|antal|stykpris"`, satsen i procent).
>   Den har *ingen* MCP-tool: MCP-pendanten er det typede `invoice_issue`, der
>   tager en fuld `InvoicePayload` med færdigberegnede totaler. En agent over MCP
>   bruger altså `invoice_issue` (typet payload) — `invoice create` er
>   CLI-ergonomien for et menneske.
> - **`invoice repair-posting` er CLI-only og administrativ.** Kommandoen
>   erstatter atomisk ét eksplicit navngivet, uklassificeret legacy-journalbilag
>   med en kanonisk fakturabogføring plus modpostering. Den afviser fakturaer med
>   betalinger, krav, kreditnotaer eller anden følge-evidens og kræver åbne
>   perioder, `--legacy-journal-entry-id`, `--reason` og actor-attribution. Den
>   eksponeres bevidst ikke som et generelt MCP-reversal-tool.
> - **`invoice export-public` og `invoice export-public-oioubl` er CLI-only.**
>   De skriver deterministiske handoff-artefakter til offentlig e-faktura
>   (henholdsvis et EAN/GLN-preview og et OIOUBL-handoff) uden PEPPOL-transport.
>   Der findes ingen `*_export_public*` MCP-tools — MCP-surface'en eksponerer kun
>   `peppol_submit_public_invoice` til den egentlige PEPPOL-submission.
> - **`portfolio_overview`** dækker delvist det CLI'en eksponerer som
>   `dashboard`, men er et workspace-tool (`workspace`-parameter, ikke
>   `company`).
> - **`customer_validate_vat` (MCP) vs. `customer validate-vat` (CLI)** —
>   begge overflader klassificerer den cache-skrivende handling som en
>   bekræftet mutation.
>
> ### Den oprindelige løse note (for historisk reference)
>
> Flere CLI-kommandoer eksponeres ikke som tools, fx `init`, `serve`,
> `report *`, `vat momsangivelse`/`vat filing`, `period reopen`,
> `gdpr erase`, `opening-balance post`, `bank-account add`/`list`,
> `import run`/`systems`/`contacts`, `agent run`, `reg coverage`/`reg citations`,
> `invoice create`, `invoice repair-posting`, `invoice export-public`/`invoice export-public-oioubl` og
> diverse `system export-*`/`verify-*`-kommandoer. Disse driver lokale
> workflows eller hører til den indbyggede `agent run`-loop og er bevidst
> holdt uden for den løse agent-surface.

### Historiske afvigelser (samlet i den nye liste ovenfor)

- **`period_list` har ingen CLI-kommando.** Tool'et `period_list` lister
  regnskabsperioder over MCP, men CLI'en har kun `period close` — der er
  ingen `period list`-kommando. (Tidligere noterede dette dokument
  `period list` som en CLI-kommando "der skal bygges"; den er aldrig blevet
  bygget. MCP-tool'et læser `accounting_periods` direkte.) Vil man genskabe
  1:1-mappingen skal en `period list`-CLI-kommando tilføjes — ellers er
  dette en bevidst, dokumenteret afvigelse.
_(De oprindelige løse notater er nu listet eksplicit pr. fil i sektionerne
"MCP-only — tools uden CLI-pendant" og "CLI-only — kommandoer uden
MCP-pendant" ovenfor.)_

limitations: Static baseline inventory only: no business journeys, provider/network calls, native builds, auth setup or accepted effects rerun. No runtime parity PASS is claimed.
